This weapon leeches Void debuffs when damaging targets that are suppressed, weakened, or volatile. Once charged, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to swap firing modes. In this mode, damage from this weapon applies the same Void debuffs that were leeched.

Dealing damage charges 'Void Leech Mode'.

Scoring 27 Weapon Hits:
• Charges one currently uncharged <void/>Void Debuff
• Uncharged debuffs are granted in the following order: <void/>Volatile 🠚 <void/>Weaken 🠚 <void/>Suppression

Scoring 6 Weapon Hits on a <void/>Void debuffed target, or having a <void/>Void debuff applied to you by an enemy instantly leeches that debuff into your gun.

Both hit counters can progress simultaneously (E.g.: Leeching <void/>Weaken off a target also counts as 6 shots toward charging <void/>Volatile).

Leeching any <void/>Void Debuff off a target, or having all three <void/>Void Debuffs charged, enables you to Hold [Reload] and activate 'Void Leech' for <pve 15 /> <pvp [10] /> seconds. 

Void Leech mode grants 20% increased damage and appplies all stored <void/>Void Debuffs on hit.
